# 金山词霸 (Kingsoft iCIBA)

> AI-powered online translation and dictionary platform supporting 177 languages with text, document, and image translation capabilities.

金山词霸 (Kingsoft iCIBA) is a comprehensive translation and vocabulary learning platform that combines AI-powered translation services with an extensive online dictionary. It serves users across multiple devices including Windows, Mac, iOS, and Android, offering both professional translation tools and English language learning resources.

## Key Topics

- AI翻译 (AI Translation)
- 在线翻译 (Online Translation)
- 文档翻译 (Document Translation)
- 图片翻译 (Image Translation)
- 英语词典 (English Dictionary)
- 中英翻译 (Chinese-English Translation)
- 词汇学习 (Vocabulary Learning)
- 音标 (Phonetic Guide)
- 用法例句 (Usage Examples)
- 网页翻译 (Web Translation)
- 多语言支持 (Multilingual Support)
- AI对话 (AI Conversation)
- 考试备考 (Exam Preparation)
- 跨平台应用 (Cross-platform App)

## Core Translation Services

- [金山词霸 - 首页](https://www.iciba.com): Kingsoft iCIBA homepage: AI-powered online translation for 177 languages with document and image translation
- [金山词霸翻译服务](https://translate.iciba.com): Kingsoft translation service: AI-powered text, document and image translation supporting 177 languages

## Dictionary & Word Reference

- [在线翻译词典](https://www.iciba.com/word): Dictionary entry for '在线翻译' with definitions, pronunciation, usage and examples
- [在线翻译词典 (HTTP)](http://www.iciba.com/word): Dictionary entry with Chinese-English translations, phonetics and usage examples

## Vocabulary Learning

- [背单词 - 在线背单词平台](https://word.iciba.com): iCIBA word study platform: vocabulary learning for TOEFL, IELTS, GRE and exam prep
